name.local: 富邦創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Fubon Financial Holding (one of Taiwan's largest financial groups). Invests in high-growth-potential or stable-profit unlisted companies, with focus on biotech/healthcare, green energy, AI and new-materials technology, and also participates in public infrastructure, environmental and renewable-energy projects.

application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investor engaged through the Fubon FHC ecosystem and direct sourcing.

summary.en: Fubon Venture Capital is the corporate venture arm of Fubon Financial Holding, founded in October 2003 and headquartered in Taipei. Its main shareholders are Fubon Financial Holdings, Fubon Life, Fubon Insurance and Fubon Securities. It targets biotech/healthcare, green energy, AI and new-materials startups.
summary.local: 富邦創投為富邦金控旗下企業創投，成立於2003年10月，總部位於台北。主要股東為富邦金控、富邦人壽、富邦產險及富邦證券，投資方向包含生技醫療、綠能科技、人工智慧及新材料科技。

name.local: 中國信託創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned corporate venture arm of CTBC Financial Holding. Invests in unlisted companies with development potential across information/communications, green technology, biotech/healthcare, consumer goods, cultural/creative and software-service industries, with emphasis on supporting Taiwanese SMEs and the cultural-creative sector.

application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investor; engages through CTBC Holding ecosystem and direct sourcing.

summary.en: CTBC Venture Capital is a 100%-owned subsidiary of CTBC Financial Holding, established in 2003 (ROC year 92) and headquartered in Taipei. It invests in unlisted companies across ICT, green tech, biotech/healthcare, consumer and cultural-creative sectors.
summary.local: 中國信託創投成立於民國92年（2003），為中信金控100%持股之子公司，總部位於台北。投資對象涵蓋資訊通訊、綠色科技、生技醫療、民生消費、文化創意等具發展潛力之未上市櫃公司。

name.local: 元大創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Yuanta Financial Holdings. Provides capital plus management-consulting and integrated investment-banking services (financial advisory, M&A, IPO underwriting), targeting high-potential industries across Taiwan, Greater China and major Asian financial markets.

application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investor; engages through Yuanta FHC ecosystem.

summary.en: Yuanta Venture Capital, established December 2002, is the venture arm of Yuanta Financial Holdings, headquartered in Taipei. It offers capital alongside management consulting and investment-banking services, investing across Taiwan, Greater China, Hong Kong, Korea and Southeast Asia.
summary.local: 元大創投成立於2002年12月，為元大金控旗下創投，總部位於台北。除提供資金外，亦提供管理顧問與投資銀行服務，投資區域涵蓋台灣、大中華、香港、韓國及東南亞。

name.local: 台新創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned corporate venture arm of Taishin (now Taishin Shin Kong) Financial Holding. Invests in unlisted equity across information, internet, biotech, medical, green energy, machinery and cultural-creative industries, domestically and overseas.

application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investor; engages through Taishin FHC ecosystem.

summary.en: Taishin Venture Capital (originally Taishin/Taisin VC, set up September 2003 and renamed October 2006) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Taishin Financial Holding (now Taishin Shin Kong FHC). It invests in unlisted equity across IT, internet, biotech, medical, green energy, machinery and cultural-creative sectors.
summary.local: 台新創投原為台欣創投，設立於2003年9月，2006年10月更名為台新創投，為台新金控（現台新新光金控）全資子公司。投資未上市股權，領域涵蓋資訊、網路、生技、醫療、綠能、機械、文創等產業。

name.local: 合作金庫創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned corporate venture arm of Taiwan Cooperative Financial Holding (TWSE: 5880). Invests in early-stage startups across information/digital, cybersecurity, precision-health, defense/strategic, green/renewable-energy and strategic-stockpile industries.

application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investor; engages through Taiwan Cooperative FHC ecosystem.

summary.en: Taiwan Cooperative Venture Capital is 100%-owned by Taiwan Cooperative Financial Holding (5880), headquartered in Taipei, with an asset size of about NT$2.11 billion. It backs early-stage startups in digital, cybersecurity, precision-health, defense/strategic and green-energy industries; 31 projects invested with ROA 10.05% / ROE 11.82% through December 2025.
summary.local: 合庫創投為合作金庫金控（5880）100%持股子公司，總部位於台北，資產規模約新台幣21.1億元。投資資訊數位、資安、精準健康、國防戰略及綠能等早期新創；截至2025年12月已投資31案，ROA 10.05%、ROE 11.82%。

name.local: 創新工業技術移轉股份有限公司 / 工業技術投資公司

strategy.thesis: Venture arm of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), Taiwan's flagship R&D consortium. One of Taiwan's first VCs, it nurtures industry leaders across integrated circuits, automation, opto-electronic display, AI, blockchain and IoT, leveraging ITRI's 6,000+ tech experts and patent portfolio.

application.how_to_apply: Pitch directly via ITIC; also runs a CVC advisory program helping listed companies make their first startup investments.

summary.en: ITIC is the venture arm of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), founded in 1979 and headquartered in Taipei. One of Taiwan's first VCs, it has invested over US$400 million globally, was an original shareholder of UMC and AU Optronics, and runs multiple funds (Golden Asia, Digital Economy, ITRI Entrepreneur).
summary.local: ITIC（工業技術投資公司）為工研院（ITRI）旗下創投，成立於1979年，總部位於台北。為台灣最早的創投之一，累計投資逾4億美元，曾為聯電（UMC）、友達光電原始股東，旗下設有Golden Asia、數位經濟、ITRI創業家等多檔基金。

strategy.thesis: Corporate-VC-based platform accelerator run by Chunghwa Telecom (Taiwan's largest telecom). Integrates group resources to give startups technical support, proof-of-concept fields, business and capital matchmaking, focused on 5G, AI and digital transformation.

program.eligibility: ROC-registered startups established after 1 Jan 2018 and operating under 8 years, or SMEs meeting government standards, working on AI innovation and ESG.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the 5G Accelerator activity webpage (cht5g.com.tw) or contact startup@cht.com.tw.

summary.en: The Chunghwa Telecom 5G Accelerator, founded in 2018, is Taiwan's first telecom 5G accelerator, a CVC-platform program that has selected 82 startups by end-2025, focused on 5G, AI and digital transformation.
summary.local: 中華電信5G加速器成立於2018年，為台灣第一個電信5G加速器，係基於企業創投（CVC）的平台加速器，至2025年底已選出82家新創團隊，專注於5G、AI與數位轉型領域。

name.local: 台灣大哥大 / 台灣大新創開發

strategy.thesis: Telecom corporate-venture strategy of Taiwan Mobile (Fubon/Tsai-group-affiliated telecom), led by president Jamie Lin (AppWorks founder). Pursues a 'venture-capital-style' development strategy, taking strategic stakes in startups across esports/gaming, Japanese-anime content, AI, Web3 and green energy to complement its telecom and e-commerce (momo) businesses.

notable_investments.company: Fubon Energy (富邦能源, with Hod(泓德) Energy & Fubon Life)

application.how_to_apply: Strategic corporate investor; engages startups directly and via AppWorks ecosystem.

summary.en: Taiwan Mobile pursues a venture-capital-style corporate-investment strategy under president Jamie Lin (AppWorks founder), having invested in 30+ startups across esports/gaming, AI, Web3, e-commerce (91APP, momo) and green energy (Fubon Energy). It used subsidiary Taiwan Mobile Innovation to acquire an 18% stake in CloudMile.
summary.local: 台灣大哥大在總經理林之晨（AppWorks創辦人）領導下採行創投式企業投資戰略，已轉投資逾30家新創，涵蓋電競遊戲、AI、Web3、電商（91APP、momo）及綠能（富邦能源）。並透過子公司台灣大新創開發入股萬里雲（CloudMile）18%股權。
